extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Materials and properties — materials are substances objects are made of: wood, glass, metal, plastic, cloth, paper, rubber. Properties: hardness (metal, wood), softness (rubber, cotton), transparency (glass — see through), opacity (wood — cannot see through), flexibility (cloth, rubber — bends), rigidity (wood, glass — does not bend), waterproof (plastic, metal), absorbent (cotton, blotting paper — soaks water). (2) Solutions — a solution is made when a solid dissolves in a liquid. The solid that dissolves is the solute (sugar, salt), the liquid that dissolves it is the solvent (water), and the result is the solution. Stirring helps dissolving. (3) Soluble and non-soluble — soluble substances dissolve in water (sugar, salt, milk powder, coffee, lemon juice). Non-soluble substances do NOT dissolve (sand, chalk powder, oil, sawdust, iron filings). (4) Effect of temperature on solubility — heating water increases solubility. More sugar dissolves in hot water than in cold water. Stirring also helps dissolving. (5) Sink and float — objects float if they are less dense than water (wood, cork, wax candle, plastic bottle, dry leaf). Objects sink if they are denser than water (iron nail, glass marble, stone, steel spoon, coin). A large wooden plank floats even though it is heavy because wood is less dense than water. A small iron nail sinks even though it is light because iron is denser than water. (6) Air pollution — causes: factory smoke, vehicle exhaust, burning garbage and coal, firecrackers. Effects: coughing, asthma, lung diseases, global warming. Prevention: plant trees, use public transport, use clean fuel (CNG, solar), wear masks in polluted areas, avoid burning waste, regular vehicle checks. Misconceptions: 'heavy objects always sink and light objects always float' (a large wooden plank is heavy but floats because wood is less dense than water, a small iron nail is light but sinks because iron is denser than water), 'sand dissolves in water if you stir long enough' (sand is non-soluble — it will never dissolve no matter how long you stir), 'cold water dissolves more sugar than hot water' (hot water dissolves MORE sugar because higher temperature increases solubility), 'all plastics are the same' (plastics have different properties — some are rigid, some are flexible, some are transparent, some are opaque). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function SolutionsFloatGame), NOT export default. Export interface SolutionsFloatGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
